decision.rationale: No candidate passed every preregistered resource and wall-time threshold.

limitations: The report characterizes one pinned corpus on one host; worker or storage conclusions do not transfer automatically to other repositories or platforms.
Phase CPU attribution is sampled process CPU assigned to the latest observed process-local phase; exact IndexingDiagnostics wall times remain the phase-owner source of truth.
RSS and SQLite main/WAL/SHM values are sampled high-water observations and can miss peaks shorter than the configured interval.

The per-index deadline requests cooperative cancellation. An in-process worker cannot safely kill its indexing thread and joins it after a grace violation; the supervising parent imposes a separate hard subprocess bound and kills a worker that fails to exit. cancellation_grace_exceeded records the in-process contract violation.

Cancellation probes request cooperative cancellation after the target phase is observed. A single SQLite FTS statement or commit may finish before cancellation is checked; the report preserves the resulting generation instead of assuming rollback.

Fresh subprocesses and SQLite paths isolate process initialization and database state, but the profiler does not evict the corpus from the operating-system page cache. The mirrored worker order counterbalances order effects; this is not a cold-disk measurement.
The snapshot copies ignore-visible regular files and does not vendor the external corpus or preserve Git metadata.
